cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Graduate Engineer to join our team.
This position is designed for aspiring and entry-level engineers seeking expedited training, exposure to operations leadership, and career growth. This role will help support innovation, process efficiency, equipment reliability, quality assurance, and more with an overarching focus on compliance, safety & health throughout the facility.
Our leadership team is seeking talent from many disciplines including (but not limited to):
Process Control Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering
Engineers will generally be placed into roles such as Process Engineer, Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, Reliability Engineer, Process Control Engineer, etc. Specific job duties/responsibilities are dependent upon the role and location offered.
Our Team
The [Location masked] Plant is part of the Gypsum Wallboard products manufacturing operation. We are proud to safely manufacture quality products that have a competitive advantage and solid growth within the marketplace.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Embrace influential leadership to support the organization while advancing our [Product name masked] culture.
Work closely with engineers and operators to troubleshoot process, quality, and equipment issues and evaluate and implement improvement ideas.
Assist with Root Cause Analysis process and corrective actions.
Participate in continuous improvement efforts.
Collaborate with the work system team to review and analyze loss analysis and asset tracking data to identify equipment reliability and performance issues (gap analysis) and assist with the development of improvement plans.
Assist with the troubleshooting of operational issues and analyze efficiency and equipment reliability data.
cond_0001.requirements:

Enrolled in or have recently completed an Engineering degree program and eligible for full-time employment.
Able to work in [Location masked] without sponsorship.

Previous internship or co-op experience.

This position is designed for aspiring and entry-level engineers seeking expedited training, exposure to operations leadership, and career growth. Working alongside the team, you will help support innovation, process efficiency, equipment reliability, quality assurance, and more, with an overarching focus on compliance, safety, and health throughout the facility.
We are looking for talent from many disciplines including (but not limited to):
Process Control Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering
Engineers will generally be placed into roles such as Process Engineer, Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, Reliability Engineer, Process Control Engineer, etc. Specific job duties and responsibilities are dependent upon the role and location offered.
The plant is part of the Gypsum Wallboard products manufacturing operation. We are proud to safely manufacture quality products that have a competitive advantage and solid growth within the marketplace.
cond_0549.responsibilities:
Work alongside the organization to support and advance a shared culture of continuous improvement.
Coordinate with engineers and operators to troubleshoot process, quality, and equipment issues and evaluate and implement improvement ideas together.
Assist with Root Cause Analysis process and corrective actions.
Participate in continuous improvement efforts.
Work with the work system team to review and analyze loss analysis and asset tracking data to identify equipment reliability and performance issues (gap analysis) and help develop improvement plans.
Support the troubleshooting of operational issues and help analyze efficiency and equipment reliability data.
cond_0549.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Enrolled in or have recently completed an Engineering degree program and eligible for full-time employment.
Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering.
Able to work in [Location masked] without sponsorship.
Preferred Requirements
Previous internship or co-op experience.
